correctness.rationale: The proof classifies all ridges by three deleted edges and six acyclic contracted-triangle orientations, derives outward facet normal Gram products and exactly 2n occurrences per positive 3-composition, and then obtains the CDF by integrating the order-statistic density. Independent exact rational intersection-rank and Gram checks for n=4..7 succeeded; these corroborate but do not replace the all-n argument.
